name: a2order
description: Hệ thống Quản lý Vận hành & Gọi món Thông minh cho Quán ăn / Nhà hàng vừa & nhỏ

scripts.setup: node scripts/setup-env.mjs && npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run prisma:generate --workspace=apps/server
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/server && npm run build --workspace=apps/client && npm run build --workspace=apps/cms
scripts.lint: eslint apps packages scripts && npm run typecheck
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && tsc --noEmit -p apps/server && tsc --noEmit -p apps/client && tsc --noEmit -p apps/cms
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && node --test packages/shared/test/*.test.mjs && npm run test --workspace=apps/server

author: A2Order Team
